name: @bacnh85/pi-a2a
description: A2A Protocol v1.0 bidirectional extension for the Pi coding agent — distribute tasks to remote agents, be called by them, and self-declare for local session discovery.

name: @bacnh85/pi-advisor
description: Pi extension for an automatic advisor: a second model that reviews each settled turn and injects severity-routed notes, plus an on-demand consult tool.

name: @bacnh85/pi-agy
description: Google Antigravity CLI (agy) bridge for Pi — delegate bulk scaffolding, refactors, and test generation to a leaner model.

name: @bacnh85/pi-attachments
description: Image and file attachments for Pi — converts pasted/dropped file paths into real image attachments, collapses large text pastes into readable file references, inlines text files, and pastes clipboard file references.

name: @bacnh85/pi-budget
description: Spend cap enforcement for Pi — halts the agent when session cost exceeds a --budget USD limit. Companion to pi-sub (which renders usage); this one enforces.

name: @bacnh85/pi-chatgpt-web
description: Pi extension that turns a self-hosted ChatGPT-web bridge (OpenAI-compatible, e.g. basketikun/chatgpt2api) into a Pi provider for free web-tier models.

name: @bacnh85/pi-checkpoint
description: Git-backed undo/redo for Pi — snapshots file state at each turn into a dedicated ref namespace, so /undo rolls back the last message AND its file changes. Fills PI's gap vs OpenCode's git-backed /undo /redo (PI has conversation-level /tree but not file-state snapshots).

name: @bacnh85/pi-commandcode
description: Pi extension that connects to Command Code's OpenAI-compatible Provider API.

name: @bacnh85/pi-cron
description: Scheduled jobs for Pi — cron-style jobs that fire a prompt into the live session while pi is running, with past-due catch-up and crontab export for 24/7 needs.

name: @bacnh85/pi-evolve
description: Pi extension that adds a trajectory-based self-learning loop — automatic capture, reflection, and contextual injection of learnings.

name: @bacnh85/pi-fff
description: Pi extension: FFF-powered fuzzy file and content search.

name: @bacnh85/pi-init
description: Guided AGENTS.md generation for Pi — /init scans the repo (package.json, CI, dir structure) and generates/updates AGENTS.md with build/test/lint commands, architecture, and conventions. Inspired by OpenCode's /init.

name: @bacnh85/pi-kicad
description: KiCad CAD-design extension for Pi — drive schematic capture and PCB layout via the Konnect binary over a local HTTP daemon (no MCP SDK).

name: @bacnh85/pi-model-tools
description: Unified tool-wrapping, argument repair, reasoning management, DeepSeek V4 guidance + Super Power Mode, defensive leak-cleaning, edit mismatch repair (read-notice stripping + trim-tolerant retry), and a Codex-style apply_patch diff tool for DeepSeek V4 and GLM model families from any provider.

name: @bacnh85/pi-munin
description: Pi extension that provides native Munin long-term memory tools through direct SDK integration.

name: @bacnh85/pi-notebooklm
description: Pi extension for Google NotebookLM — notebooks, sources, chat, research, and Studio artifacts via notebooklm-py CLI bridge.

name: @bacnh85/pi-notify
description: Desktop notifications and sounds for Pi — fires on task completion, errors, and when the agent asks a question. Cross-platform (macOS notification center, Linux libnotify, Windows toast, plus OSC 777/99 terminal protocols). Inspired by OpenCode's attention feature.

name: @bacnh85/pi-obsidian
description: Pi extension for Obsidian vault tools — read, search, create, and manage notes via the Obsidian CLI.

name: @bacnh85/pi-permission
description: Granular permission system for Pi — allow/ask/deny rules per tool with wildcard patterns, external-directory boundary, and a doom-loop guard. Config-driven, opt-in companion to Pi's container-first philosophy. Inspired by OpenCode's permission config.

name: @bacnh85/pi-plan
description: Plan mode with read-only gating and plan → implement → verify → review workflow for Pi.

name: @bacnh85/pi-ponytail
description: Pi-ponytail — lazy senior dev mode for your Pi agent. Forked from DietrichGebert/ponytail.

name: @bacnh85/pi-references
description: External context roots for Pi — alias sibling dirs or git repos as @docs, @sdk and reference them in chat. Auto-clones git repos into a local cache; injects descriptions into agent context. Inspired by OpenCode's references feature.

name: @bacnh85/pi-review
description: Pi extension for isolated or local read-only code review.

name: @bacnh85/pi-router
description: Pi extension that connects to any OpenAI-compatible AI router (9router, omniroute, …) via its /v1 API.

name: @bacnh85/pi-rtk
description: Pi extension that routes shell commands through RTK for token savings.

name: @bacnh85/pi-selfskills
description: Pi extension for skill self-improvement — one skill_manage tool (list/read/patch/create/restore) to patch gaps in loaded skills and create new ones, with a writable-root allowlist, SDK validation, and content-addressed backups.

name: @bacnh85/pi-serena
description: Pi extension that provides Serena semantic code tools through a persistent worker.

name: @bacnh85/pi-sub
description: Pi extension showing subscription usage for supported model providers.

name: @bacnh85/pi-subagent
description: In-process subagents for Pi with isolated SDK sessions, parallel and chained delegation, and inspectable threads.

name: @bacnh85/pi-themes
description: Custom pi themes collection — Ayu variants (dark, mirage, light) + Catppuccin Mocha

name: @bacnh85/pi-ux
description: Anti-slop UI/UX design discipline for your Pi agent — anchors a lintable DESIGN.md, runs deterministic slop-audit gates (APCA contrast + tokens + states + slop tells), works with text-only models, ships reference design-system presets.

name: @bacnh85/pi-web
description: Pi extension for web search, page extraction, Firecrawl scraping/crawling, and Crawl4AI headless browser crawling.

name: @bacnh85/pi-windows-tools
description: Pi extension for Windows-native tool manipulation — shell profiles, path conversion, command execution, WSL bridge, safety policy, and developer tool discovery.
